svg.title: One simple random sample of 20 people drawn from a population of 200
svg.desc: Grid of 200 dots for a hypothetical population with 80 supporters, so p = 0.40. Twenty dots chosen by chance are ringed and copied into a sample of 20; 7 of the 20 support the proposal, so p-hat = 0.35.
svg.text: Inference: use the statistic p̂ to estimate the parameter p
